title: polemonium caeruleum f. vulgare
intro: Polemonium caeruleum f. vulgare, commonly known as Sky Pilot, is a flowering plant species belonging to the Polemonium genus. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, and its ability to support respiratory health. The therapeutic actions of Polemonium caeruleum f. vulgare include expectorant and anti-tussive properties, helping to relieve coughs and ease respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
